Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1496
Claimant:
Tina Woods
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
10-6-23
First notice of loss received for a side impact collision at a signalized intersection involving the insured vehicle and
one other vehicle. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed thorugh their office.
10-8-23
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of the loss. No issues with
coverage identified at this stage.
12-12-23
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant's vehicle at the scene and documents the point of impact on the
driver's side. Responding officers noted the damage pattern was consistent with the reported sequence of events.
12-31-23
Spoke with the other driver, who gave an account matching the claimant's description of how the collision happened.
Independent witnesses and scene photographs are consistent with the same version of events.
1-3-24
Vehicle inspection completed. The damage is largely in line with the impact described, concentrated on the driver's
side door, quarter panel and B-pillar area. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the inspection.
2-4-24
Reviewed prior claims and underwriting history. Nothing suggests any damage to this vehicle predates the start of the
current coverage period.
3-14-24
Claimant's counsel submitted the initial injury report describing neck and back strain. The reported injury is a good fit
for the type and force of the collision.
3-23-24
No record of earlier treatment or prior injury to the neck or back has been found in the medical history available to us
so far.
4-10-24
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of soft tissue injury. The treating provider's
notes are being requested to understand the course of care.
4-23-24
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in every conversation so far, including the recorded
statement and subsequent calls with counsel present.
5-12-24
File remains open pending receipt of the complete treatment records and the bodily injury demand. Next review
scheduled once those documents are in hand.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
